# SPARQL Network

The following network graph visualizes the relationships of the Wikidata item **Q138572994** (*The Adventure of Abstraction*).

The graph was generated using the Wikidata Query Service.

## SPARQL Query

```sparql
SELECT ?property ?propertyLabel ?value ?valueLabel WHERE {
  BIND(wd:Q138572994 AS ?item)

  ?item ?p ?statement .
  ?property wikibase:claim ?p .
  ?statement ?ps ?value .

  ?property wikibase:statementProperty ?ps .

  SERVICE wikibase:label {
    bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "[AUTO_LANGUAGE],en,de".
  }
}
```
